stories.title: Nizakat spins HK to 26-run victory over Uganda
stories.subTitle: ICC World Cricket League Division 2 Dubai 2011
stories.summary: Part-time bowler Nizakat Khan spun Hong Kong to a sensational 26-run victory over Uganda in the opening game at the ICC World Cricket League Division Two tournament yesterday.

stories.title: Black day on and off pitch for Hong Kong
stories.subTitle: Pepsi ICC World Cricket League Division 3 Hong Kong 2011
stories.summary: A day which began on a sombre note ended disastrously as Hong Kong slipped to a seven-wicket defeat at the hands of the United States in their opening encounter at the Pepsi ICC World Cricket League Division Three tournament.
stories.byline: By Alvin Sallay, South China Morning Post

stories.title: HK defy the odds to book Dubai spot
stories.subTitle: Pepsi ICC World Cricket League Division 3 Hong Kong 2011
stories.summary: Giving a high five can be harmful to a bowler as Nadeem Ahmed learned the hard way when he twisted the fingers of his bowling hand after slapping palms with teammate Munir Dar yesterday.
stories.byline: By Alvin Sallay, South China Morning Post
